issues.title: Isolate repository and archive original working tree
acceptance: New remote only; upstream push disabled
Original main history and license/notices preserved
Old workflows inactive; new directive authoritative

issues.title: Pin runtime, kernel, boot artifacts and frontend toolchain
acceptance: Verified checksums and immutable source refs
Document compatible native build/test commands
No unresolved toolchain pins in executable builds

issues.title: Build isolated four-fake-ship development harness
acceptance: Start/stop/reset repeatably with safe path guards
Native positive/negative smoke tests execute
No live identities or production pier fixtures

issues.title: Audit native Git dependency license and conformance
acceptance: Record licensing and reuse decision
Independently run available stock Git vectors
Document unsupported features and limits

issues.title: Freeze principal/project/command/policy contracts
acceptance: IDs are not tied to host URL or sponsorship
Schema includes request ID, expected revision and authority epoch
Document full mutation owner and authorization invariants

issues.title: Implement home state and Work/Docs transitions
acceptance: Native compile and restart persistence
No silent overwrite or duplicate accepted transition
Git-backed document canonicality and portable exports specified/tested as implemented

issues.title: Implement and adversarially test authorization
acceptance: Reader/contributor/outsider negative tests
Revocation checked at commit and on all reads
No implicit parent, sponsor or administrator bypass

issues.title: Implement isolated per-person browser sessions
acceptance: No shared +code or actor-name-only login
Expiring one-use origin/session-bound identity challenge
CSRF/replay/session isolation tests; raw endpoint bypass tests

issues.title: Implement unified browser Work/Docs flow
acceptance: Direct home content delivery; no personal-ship proxy by default
Revision conflicts and queued vs saved visible
Authorized minimal subscriptions and separate user browser tests

issues.title: Integrate native Git under authoritative policy
acceptance: Ordinary clone/fetch/push/fsck preserves OIDs
No raw engine route bypasses final policy check
Concurrent refs/revocation and malformed pack tests

issues.title: Implement reviews and scoped agent proposals
acceptance: Agent cannot self-grant merge/release permission
Review evidence bound to exact code revision
Private conversation promotion requires explicit authorization

issues.title: Implement portable project exports and restore
acceptance: Recover Git/Markdown/JSON plus authority evidence
Rebuild derived indexes from exported records
No live duplicate ship; loss window and continuity checked

issues.title: Establish native CI and independent verification
acceptance: Disposable isolated runners and synthetic fixtures
Actual native tests, not only mocked APIs
No production secrets for untrusted jobs

issues.title: Implement VPS deployment and operation runbooks
acceptance: Explicit owner-approved host/identity provisioning
Restricted admin, HTTPS and native transport checks
Backup/restore drill, resource monitoring and release rollback evidence

issues.title: Run public/synthetic live canary
acceptance: Multi-host identity and private-access tests
Concurrent import/UI workload measurements
Independent security review; sensitive data still gated

issues.title: Implement explicit project replicas and migration
acceptance: Replica custody scopes and staleness visible
Single-writer fencing and epoch migration tests
No unqualified active-active or automatic failover

issues.title: Cut over own source to native authority
acceptance: Document one source of truth before/after switch
GitHub becomes controlled one-way mirror
Demonstrate recovery without original host or application

issues.title: Design browser-only organizational identity profile
acceptance: No requirement for one ship per employee
Reviewed OIDC/passkey protocol and native feasibility decision
Individual attribution/delegation survives identity binding changes
